title: Optimization using Genetic Algorithm & Simulated Annealing
description: Population-based Genetic Algorithm and stochastic Simulated Annealing for non-linear function optimization.
aim: To implement Genetic Algorithm and Simulated Annealing metaheuristics for continuous optimization.
theory:
Genetic Algorithms (GA) mimic biological natural selection: candidate solutions (individuals) undergo selection, crossover (recombination), and mutation across successive generations to optimize a fitness objective.
Simulated Annealing (SA) mimics the thermodynamic process of metallurgical annealing: a single candidate is perturbed, and uphill moves are conditionally accepted with probability exp(-delta_E / T) allowing escape from local optima.
algorithm: Initialize population of candidate solution individuals.
Evaluate objective fitness for every individual.
Select fittest individuals as parents for mating pool.
Perform crossover to produce offspring candidates.
Replace low-fitness individuals and iterate until convergence.
